title: Tactics Formula
native_title: タクティクス・フォーミュラ
overview: Tactics Formula is an F1 racing simulation board game for up to four players. Rather than driving a course in real-time, the player instead selects the route to take for each section of track from preset points laid out on a map, keeping in mind race conditions such as the position of other vehicles, tire durability, and remaining fuel. After deciding the route for a section, the choices made play out and the player then plans the next section's route, continuing until completing the race. A real-time replay of the full race is shown once the race is complete. There are a total of 16 different tracks to race.
